label: Moss (FTS index storage format)
type: the other of two on-disk storage formats a Bleve-based FTS index partition can use. Mutually exclusive with fts:scorch-storage for a given index; hasEquivalentEffectAs it for the diagnostic commands both support (check/count/dictionary/fields/mapping/query/registry).
evidence: The name of each (whether it is a Moss or a Scorch index) is formed from the user-defined index-name, the uuid of the user-defined index...
Note that the check, count, dictionary, fields, mapping, query, and registry command-values can also be used to return information about a Scorch index.
note: Promoted as a pair with fts:scorch-storage per the family test: neither record can state what it IS without naming the other as its mutually-exclusive sibling.
relates_to_competency_question: What are the two on-disk storage formats an FTS index partition can use, and are they interchangeable?
